from t import *
import ref, json, wire as W, hashlib

def check(name, tr, manual=None):
    got = run([tr])['traces'][0]
    exp = ref.audit(tr)
    ok = json.dumps(got, sort_keys=True) == json.dumps(exp, sort_keys=True)
    bad = [] if ok else ['REF-MISMATCH']
    if manual:
        for k, v in manual.items():
            gv = got
            for part in k.split('.'):
                gv = gv[int(part)] if isinstance(gv, list) else gv[part]
            if gv != v: bad.append(f"{k}={gv!r} want {v!r}")
    print(f"== {name}: {'OK' if not bad else 'PROBLEM ' + '; '.join(bad)}")
    return got

good = envelope('I', 0, b'\x01')
# I/H annotation value rule: 0 authenticates, nonzero fails
tr = trace([datagram(good, auth=[0])])
check("ih-ann-0", tr, {'packets.0.status':'OK'})
tr = trace([datagram(good, auth=[5])])
check("ih-ann-5", tr, {'packets.0.status':'AUTH'})
tr = trace([datagram(good, auth=[None, 0])])
check("ih-ann-null0", tr, {'packets.0.status':'AUTH'})

# two coalesced I packets: attempt j uses auth[j]
tr = trace([datagram(good+good, auth=[0, 0])])
check("ih-two-ok", tr, {'packets.0.status':'OK', 'packets.1.status':'OK'})
tr = trace([datagram(good+good, auth=[0, 1])])
check("ih-two-second", tr, {'packets.1.status':'AUTH'})
tr = trace([datagram(good+good, auth=[0])])
check("ih-two-absent", tr, {'packets.1.status':'AUTH'})

# epoch rollback on frame error (phase fixed)
evs = [dict(keys=['A']), datagram(envelope('A', 0, b'\x99', width=1, phase=1), auth=[1])]
tr = trace(evs)
check("epoch-rollback", tr, {'packets.0.status':'FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR', 'packets.0.epoch':1,
                             'key_epoch':0, 'epochs':[]})

# epoch display on DUPLICATE (annotation shown), and window/parity checked before dup
evs = [dict(keys=['A']),
       datagram(envelope('A', 0, b'\x01', width=1, phase=0), auth=[0]),
       datagram(envelope('A', 0, b'\x01', width=1, phase=0), auth=[0])]
tr = trace(evs)
check("epoch-display-dup", tr, {'packets.1.status':'DUPLICATE', 'packets.1.epoch':0})
# annotation out of window beats duplicate check
evs = [dict(keys=['A']),
       datagram(envelope('A', 0, b'\x01', width=1, phase=0), auth=[0]),
       datagram(envelope('A', 0, b'\x01', width=1, phase=0), auth=[3])]
tr = trace(evs)
check("auth-before-dup", tr, {'packets.1.status':'AUTH', 'packets.1.epoch':None})

# retired_local interval merging: 5 local cids, dest=4 (ee), retire 0,1,3
cids = ['aa','bb','cc','dd','ee']
r = bytes([0x19])
tr = trace([dict(keys=['A']),
           datagram(envelope('A', 0, r+W.v(0)+r+W.v(1)+r+W.v(3), width=1, cid=b'\xee'), auth=[0])],
          local_cids=cids)
check("retired-merge", tr, {'retired_local':[[0,2],[3,4]], 'packets.0.status':'OK'})

# retiring the destination (ee=seq4) -> PV
tr = trace([dict(keys=['A']),
           datagram(envelope('A', 0, r+W.v(4), width=1, cid=b'\xee'), auth=[0])], local_cids=cids)
check("retire-dest2", tr, {'packets.0.status':'PROTOCOL_VIOLATION', 'retired_local':[]})

# retire out of range -> PV
tr = trace([dict(keys=['A']), datagram(envelope('A', 0, r+W.v(5), width=1), auth=[0])], local_cids=cids)
check("retire-oor", tr, {'packets.0.status':'PROTOCOL_VIOLATION'})

# duplicate retirement idempotent
tr = trace([dict(keys=['A']), datagram(envelope('A', 0, r+W.v(1)+r+W.v(1), width=1), auth=[0])])
check("retire-idem", tr, {'retired_local':[[1,2]]})

# DROP_CID after retirement in an earlier datagram
tr = trace([dict(keys=['A']),
           datagram(envelope('A', 0, r+W.v(1), width=1, cid=b'\xee'), auth=[0]),
           datagram(envelope('A', 1, b'\x01', width=1, cid=b'\xbb'), auth=[0])], local_cids=cids)
check("drop-after-retire", tr, {'packets.1.status':'DROP_CID'})

# retirement rolls back on later frame error in same packet
tr = trace([dict(keys=['A']), datagram(envelope('A', 0, r+W.v(1)+b'\x99', width=1), auth=[0])])
check("retire-rb2", tr, {'packets.0.status':'FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR', 'retired_local':[]})
